blocks.d: Research summaries help teams assess biological crop protection, with sources available for review.
Competitor and market research helps the team evaluate product opportunities.
Recurring content and search reviews keep growth work moving.
Routine reviews help the team track bugs, maintenance, and release readiness.

cases.lede: micoo uses Toone to support engineering delivery for its microcredential platform. Repeatable workflows keep progress, blockers, and maintenance visible so the team can focus on decisions.

blocks.d: Delivery summaries show what moved forward, what is blocked, and where the team needs to make a decision.
Recurring delivery work gives the team a consistent way to follow progress and review results.
Scheduled maintenance reviews keep recurring engineering work visible.
Technology research helps the team evaluate changes that may affect its product.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.sub: The short version of everything people ask us.
faq.a1: Toone is a native macOS workspace for projects that use AI agents: specialised agents, the repeatable routines they run, and the tools and knowledge they share, kept together in one place.
faq.a2: Anyone with an OpenAI or Anthropic subscription who wants to automate real work with AI agents, whether you already run agents or have felt left out of agentic workflows so far. Professionals and businesses use it to automate processes with reliability, consistency and determinism, while keeping observability and room to expand.
faq.q3: Do I need an existing subscription?
faq.a3: Yes. Toone works with your own OpenAI or Anthropic subscription and connects to it during setup. There is no separate model plan to buy from us.
faq.a4: A small one. You describe agents and routines in natural language, and the guided setup takes you from install to a first routine run in about fifteen minutes. The Explore page also has reviewed routines and bundles you can open in Toone and adapt.
faq.a5: Toone runs on your Mac. Your provider credentials and project files stay with you, every run is visible while it happens, and routines can pause for your approval before sensitive steps. Routines and bundles shared in Explore are reviewed before they are listed.
faq.a6: Request early access with your email. Access is offered by invitation.
faq.q7: Can I keep using my existing app?
faq.a7: Yes. Existing account holders can continue signing in with their usual method.
faq.a8: Redeem your personal code on the website to create an email and password account, then use it in the desktop app.
